name: 48423 · Davison, MI
findings: ZIP 48423 (Davison) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48423 (Davison) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48423 (Davison) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 29% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
